notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
[h2]Dear friends, we are pleased to inform you that the beta version of PvP multiplayer is now available for play! 

[h2][url=https://imgur.com/a/YjbuO0R]Brief Guide For Multiplayer - https://imgur.com/a/YjbuO0R[/url][/h2]

We invite you and your friends to play, we will be glad to hear your feedback and your opinion on this update and the game in general, thank you![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43249810/d9a7e0daa21f9c931f6e4f4b5148c0364bbafc6a.png[/img]

[h2]Multiplayer mode can be found in the list of the main game modes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43249810/e72f197e2512a40761c629353241181b879224c7.png[/img]

tags.feature: PvP multiplayer is now available for play!

notes.title: RELEASE of Trading Cards, Emoticons & BGs!
notes.content:
[h3]Friends![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43249810/d9a7e0daa21f9c931f6e4f4b5148c0364bbafc6a.png[/img]

[h3]Finally Steam approved our trading cards, backgrounds, emoticons and badges.

In total, 5 badges (+1 metal), 15 cards, 10 emoticons and 8 backgrounds were added.[/h3]


[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1861970/]CHECK IT OUT IN POINT SHOP 🐺[/url]

[url=https://steamdb.info/app/1861970/communityitems/]More information on trading cards, backgrounds and emoticons - Here 🦊[/url][/h3]


[h3]To get one trading card, you need to spend 15 minutes in the game[/h3]


[h3]We look forward to your feedback in the comments and discussions![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43249810/06e93a2058930139c64bc069fc94e1c71e896752.png[/img]

[h3]Thank you for your help and support on the way to obtaining these trading cards![/h3]

notes.title: GIVEAWAY: Steam Gift Cards & 100+ Keys
notes.content:
[b]UPD:

Friends, giveaway results:
[/b]


Everyone who participated in the giveaway can write to [b]darkfantasy.gamedev@gmail.com[/b] (with comment number and profile) and get the key for participate!
[b]

Gift Steam cards receive comments (random.org):
#154 - https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198928929047
#256 - https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198103730345
#30 - https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198147265486

Add to friends [url=]https://steamcommunity.com/id/publisheroftheworld/[/url] and get your gifts!

Thank you all for participating! Good luck in future giveaways.


Receiving a prize is actual for the next five days! You will receive a key within a week. Who will write later than January 5 - 21:00 Moscow, will not receive a prize!


[h3]Thank you for such positive feedback for the game![/h3][/b]

[h3]Friends, today we would like to start a [b]Giveaway[/b]:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]$10 Steam Gift Cards x3[/b]

[*] [b]100+ Steam Keys[/b]
[/list]

[h3]These prizes are Waiting For You! :)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36298114/c80a81600953a4c14234bf0ffa73c6a4d970e458.png[/img]

[b]Friends[/b], to take part in the [b]giveaway[/b], you should:
[olist]
[*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1861970/Mister_Furry/]Add the game[/url] to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b] (if it is not already in your Steam library)

[*][b]Share this announcement with all who you knows! :)[/b]
Click "[b]Share[/b]" under this news, then "[b]Share directly to my status[/b]", write something and click "[b]Post[/b]"

[*][b]Tell us your opinion about the game in the comments[/b] under this announcement! [b]We will be very happy to hear it from you![/b]
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36298114/6eafadb50d5228926cad543fe55acb1c4a5350c0.png[/img]
[h3]We will announce the results of the giveaway on December 30, 2022! Good luck![/h3]

Guys, we also would like to remind you in a friendly manner that we, as you are waiting for, and really want to get that[b] trading cards[/b] and [b]add new levels[/b] to the game.

But the development of the game in terms of adding trading cards, adding new levels, features and much more depends entirely on [b]your activity[/b] - [b]the number of additions of the game to the wishlist[/b], [b]the activity on the store page & in the discussions of the game[/b], [b]the number of game launches[/b], [b]the time spent in the game.[/b]

All this affects [b]to how fast we'll get trading cards[/b] and this[b] helps us[/b] to get them! Thank you for understanding! :)

[b][h3]We can do it together![/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43249810/e72f197e2512a40761c629353241181b879224c7.png[/img]
[h3]We will be very grateful if you tell your friends about the game, write your opinion in comments or reviews and add it to your wishlist if you're liked it!
[/h3]

Thank you! :)
